name: – Brando Benifei – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT on opportunities and challenges presented by a comprehensive artificial intelligence strategy for EU trade
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how artificial intelligence should shape the European Union's trade policy. It is not a law. It asks the European Commission to use AI to help small companies export, to speed up customs checks, to protect data and workers, to secure supplies of computer chips and rare minerals, and to push the Union's human-centred AI rules as a global standard through the World Trade Organization and deals with like-minded partners.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of requests to the Commission, not binding law.
- **Who it affects:** EU exporters, small businesses, customs authorities, tech and chip suppliers, workers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
